Explorers

SPACEEXPLORERS

Probes, landers and rovers that NASA left across the Moon, Mars and deep space. Find each one and build your own museum.

▾ How to play

There are 24 pieces of NASA equipment abandoned on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space. Find each one to unlock it in the museum.

  • You start on Earth, next to the rocket. Visit the museum (door on the right, Enter to go in): before the mission, everything is locked in black.
  • A D / arrows walk, W or Space jump, Shift runs faster, Enter interacts. To leave from anywhere, return to the rocket and press Enter.
  • In space: WASD / arrows move the rocket, Shift brakes, Space turns on turbo. Approach a planet or moon slowly and press Enter to land.
  • On the surface, follow the mission clue and press Enter near the equipment to store its data in your case. It holds up to 4; then return to the rocket (Enter) to log everything.
  • C changes the camera (inside/outside the rocket). On Earth, when you board, you enter the rocket room: click LAUNCH for the 5-second countdown. The ♪ button turns sound on/off.
  • Deep-space probes are found by flying slowly up to them.
  • Gravity pulls on you gently. The Sun burns the hull, and crashes into planets and moons cause damage. The asteroid belt is almost empty, as in reality: you can cross it safely. With no fuel, only a rescue brings you back. Refuel on Earth.
  • On mobile: touch and hold the screen to head in that direction; use the buttons at the side.

Sources

Independent educational game, not officially affiliated with NASA. Images belong to their sources (JPL Photojournal, NASA Image and Video Library). The “last transmissions” are first-person educational reconstructions, and scale comparisons are approximations.
